key_claims.claim: Doula support is associated with lower preterm birth and cesarean delivery rates, improved birth experience, and higher postpartum visit attendance at moderate certainty.
Emerging data on GLP-1 receptor agonist periconception exposure are synthesized but remain limited and largely observational.
A reduced-visit antenatal care model (four in-person plus two telemedicine visits) appears non-inferior to standard eight-visit care in low-risk Swedish women.
Selective reduction in monochorionic pregnancies with sFGR yields pooled co-twin survival and gestational age estimates that vary by surgical technique.
Higher first-trimester FMF estimated risk and specific biomarker profiles predict breakthrough preterm preeclampsia among aspirin-treated high-risk women.
